subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Any of the boy__ in my team are very intelligent.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Some of the boys**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We use **any** to mean 'it does not matter which or what', to describe something which is not limited.
 
• As a general rule, we use **'some'** for affirmative sentences, and **'any'** for questions or negative sentences.
 
• **Example -** 
 
 
• *Some of them__ are tender; some of them are wise.*
 
• *I had never eaten __any__ kind of Thai food.*
 
 
 
• *​*The given sentence means that, **My team includes a number of very bright young men.**
 
• So,** 'some of the boys' **is** **the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence:** *Some of the boys in my team are very intelligent.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• We use **all, **before indefinite plural nouns referring to a whole class of people or things.

 
 
• **Example -** *All cats love milk.*
